brief:
## Affected callers
- Identifier resolution calls the timeline selector before namespace, named-import, and same-file fallback lookup; a nonempty result is returned through `candidates_outcome` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1510`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1742`).
- Usage filtering resolves hit spans in batches of eight and retains hits whose returned definitions intersect the requested overloads; the Python timeline branch contributes those definitions (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/searchtools/scan_usages.rs:1714`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/searchtools/scan_usages.rs:1738`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1742`).
- Rename target selection uses source-backed definition lookup after declaration-span selection, then requires `Resolved` status and exactly one definition; Python identifier lookup passes through the changed event selector (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/symbol_rename.rs:337`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/symbol_rename.rs:341`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/symbol_rename.rs:359`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1742`).
- The new regression's `definition_at` invokes the shared `call_tool` helper, which holds `CALL_TOOL_LOCK`, creates a fresh `SearchToolsService` without a semantic index, and parses its JSON response (`tests/suite_issues/issue_2053_python_module_rebindings.rs:26`, `tests/common/search_tools.rs:23`).

## Paths
- Batch requests reach `resolve_one`, whose Python dispatch invokes `resolve_python`; its identifier branch reaches the changed timeline-event selection (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/mod.rs:624`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/mod.rs:1343`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1510`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1742`).
- Event selection uses `usize::MAX` for references inside function or lambda bodies and the reference start offset otherwise; it then takes visible events beginning at the last unconditional event before invoking the new declaration selector for `Other` events (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1667`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1679`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1742`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1910`).
- The new helper's vector joins the enclosing timeline result; identifier resolution returns `candidates_outcome` for a nonempty `Some` result, a namespace module if one is bound, and otherwise a `no_indexed_definition` diagnostic, while a `None` result continues to namespace, named-import, and same-file lookup (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1777`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1523`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1537`).

## Value flow
- `PythonDefinitionContext::build` groups every declaration in the file by `unit.identifier()` and sorts each group; the changed `Other` event branch takes its candidate slice from this map (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1982`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1741`).
- The timeline collector records functions and classes at their node end offsets, assignments at their node end offsets, and loop targets at the left-hand node end offset; these offsets are passed as `event_visible_from` and compared with declaration range end offsets in the new helper (`crates/bifrost-python/src/graph/extractor.rs:1632`, `crates/bifrost-python/src/graph/extractor.rs:1648`, `crates/bifrost-python/src/graph/extractor.rs:1660`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1771`).
- The new helper first applies the existing same-file visibility filter, which admits module children and earlier members of the enclosing class; the identifier fallback also calls that filter directly (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1767`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1865`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1541`).
- Each module-level assignment to a name builds a `Field` CodeUnit from the module FQN and that name and passes it to `replace_code_unit`, which calls `remove_code_unit` (clearing the unit's `ranges` entry) and then `add_code_unit` with the current assignment node; the unit's stored range is that of the most recently visited assignment for the name (`crates/bifrost-python/src/declarations.rs:551`, `crates/bifrost-python/src/declarations.rs:569`, `crates/bifrost-core/src/analyzer/parsed_file.rs:274`, `crates/bifrost-core/src/analyzer/parsed_file.rs:425`); the event selector reads these ranges through `analyzer.ranges(candidate)` (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1773`).
- Declaration end offsets and the AST lookup span in the new helper come from `analyzer.ranges(candidate)`; Python delegates ranges to its inner analyzer, which reads the unit's range vector from file state, including snapshot and current-source lookup routes (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1773`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1784`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/python/mod.rs:518`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/tree_sitter_analyzer.rs:9642`).
- Timeline conditional flags recognize if, try, except, match, case, for, and while ancestry; the new branch-path comparison records if/elif arm ancestry, excluding condition expressions, and stops at module, function, or class boundaries (`crates/bifrost-python/src/graph/extractor.rs:1873`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1799`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1824`).
- Selected candidates are sorted and deduplicated before leaving the timeline selector; `candidates_outcome` determines status from distinct `(FQN, kind)` keys; a field and function with the same FQN contribute separate keys (`crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1796`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/python.rs:1754`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/mod.rs:1475`, `crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/mod.rs:1726`).
rationale: Restated the module-assignment item as a plain description of replace_code_unit removing and re-adding the single Field unit's range per assignment, and removed the linking phrasing from the two items the judges cited (the 'maximum eligible declaration end' bound and the empty-result path 'before reaching the later same-file fallback'), keeping all anchors.
